info.name: Shoppable Commerce API Suite Catalog API

items.docs:
Query the Shoppable catalog. Supports keyword search, retailer/brand/category filters, price sorting, and date-range filtering on product update times.

**Response shapes:**
- Default (per-variation): each row in `products` is an individual SKU/variation. Variations within the same `partNumber` group are sorted by size (S, M, L, XL, 2XL, 3XL, ...).
